title: GPT-5 mini is back on the menu, with docs beside it
summary:
A maintenance-heavy day: restored GPT-5-mini access, clearer API docs, and sturdier image and queue plumbing.

GPT-5-mini was added to the Enter registry so requests resolve correctly again, and the API documentation got a refresh to make the available paths less of an archaeological dig.

The image service received model restrictions and supporting enhancements, tightening up how image requests are routed and handled across the service.

Registry configuration was simplified around DPT handling while the queue system was overhauled for steadier model scheduling. Less special-case machinery, fewer opportunities for the machinery to develop opinions.

highlights.title: New Model: GPT-5 Mini
highlights.text: Added support for `gpt-5-mini` to the text generation API. Try it in your next request!

highlights.title: Interactive API Docs
highlights.text: Launched new interactive documentation with request validation and schemas. Check it out at [enter.pollinations.ai/docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs).
